title: NEXTTEC 96 WELL PLATE DNA Extraction EFGL
author: EagleFish GeneticsLab
materials: Gather the items you need to do your DIGESTION a. Proteinase K (Pro-K) - in refrigerator b. 8 channel 0.5 µL to 10 µL pipette and full box of tips c. 1000 µL pipette and tips d. 25 mL plastic reservoir e. Nexttec aluminum sealing tape (foil seal) or Thermo heat sealing foil (heat seal) f. brayer (roller) g. Gloves

Gather the items you need to do your FINAL PREP a. Your extraction tray (from incubator) b. Your prepared Nexttec Cleanplate filter tray assembly from step 3 c. A multi-channel 10 µL to 100 µL pipette and full box of tips d. Nexttec sealing tape (clear plastic seal) e. Thermo heat sealing foil (heat seal) f. Gloves

steps.title: Gather Extraction Materials
steps.instruction: Collect all necessary items for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Print extraction sheet/map from the GTSeq Extraction Template (S:\Eagle Fish Genetics Lab\LAB PROTOCOL BOOK\03- Opening a New Project\GTseq).
Buffer G (from refrigerator).
Deep-well plate (Cat. #:10924-F-NX).
Plastic reservoir.
8-channel pipette (30 µL to 300 µL) and tip box.
Ethanol, beaker for ethanol, and Kim Wipes.
Punch tool with 3.0mm tip and mat.
Scissors and forceps.
Gloves.

steps.title: Prepare Deep-Well Plate
steps.instruction: Inspect and label the deep-well plate, then dispense Buffer G.

substeps.instruction: Inspect plate for cracks or breaks; notify Lab Manager if damaged.
Label the side of the plate with Project Name, Tray #, Date, and Initials.
Pour ~8 mL of Buffer G into the reservoir per plate.
Using an 8-channel pipette, dispense 70 µL of Buffer G into each well of the deep-well plate.

steps.title: Deposit Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue samples into the deep-well plate according to the extraction map.

substeps.instruction: For samples on vacuum-sealed Whatman sheets: Place sheet on mat, use 3.0mm punch tool to punch sample (including fin clip/tape) and deposit into the appropriate well.

For samples in vials: Array vials in rack by A1 corner; remove tissue with forceps, snip a piece roughly the size of the letter 'O', blot with Kim Wipe to remove ethanol, and place in the deep-well tray.
Rinse all tools with ethanol and blot dry between each sample.
Mark an 'X' at the top of vials that are completely empty.
Note any sample issues (e.g., dried up, used up (uu), small sample (ss), or brittle tissue) on the extraction sheet.
Repeat until the whole tray is extracted (typically 95 samples), ensuring the No Template Control (NTC) well remains empty.

steps.title: Perform Tissue Digestion
steps.instruction: Add Proteinase K (Pro-K) and incubate the samples.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 980 µL of Pro-K (or 10 µL per sample including control well) into a 25 mL reservoir using a 1000 µL pipette.
Using an 8-channel pipette and new p10 tips, dispense 10 µL of Pro-K into each well, including the NTC well. Discard tips after each row.

Heat seal the plate: Place heat sealing foil white side up, press firmly for 5-6 seconds, rotate tray, and repeat press. Enforce seal with a brayer or fingers. Use foil strips or lab tape on edges if necessary.
Centrifuge the plate at 3000 RPM for 1 minute.
Incubate the plate at 56 °C for a minimum of 3 to 4 hours, preferably overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Tray
steps.instruction: Prepare the Nexttec Cleanplate filter tray for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Gather: Nexttec Cleanplate (Cat. #: 10924-F-NX), Prep Buffer (Cat. #: 10924-F-NX), 50 mL falcon tube, skirted PCR plate, repeating pipette with 5 mL combi-tip, Nexttec Sealing Tape, and gloves.
Unwrap Cleanplate and inspect for cracks or yellow hue.
Pour roughly 35 mL of Prep buffer into a 50 mL falcon tube.
Calibrate the repeater pipette by dispensing once into the falcon tube, then dispense 350 µL of Prep Buffer into each well of the filter tray.
Refill any missed wells with 350 µL of buffer.
Seal the plate with Nexttec Sealing Tape and press by hand.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 2640 RPM for 1 minute.
Verify each well contains buffer; repeat dispensing/spinning for any empty wells.
Place the filter plate onto a labeled skirted PCR plate (Project Name, Tray #, Date, Initials).
Discard the deep-well plate used for spinning down Prep Buffer.
If not used immediately, store in refrigerator for up to 1 week (preferably <1 day).

steps.title: Final DNA Preparation
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate from the extraction tray to the filter tray to isolate DNA.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve extraction tray from incubator and centrifuge at 3000 RPM for 1 minute.
Remove the aluminum/heat seal from the extraction tray.
Remove the plastic seal from the filter tray (save for later).
Using an 8-channel pipette set to 80 µL, transfer all lysate solution from extraction wells to corresponding filter tray wells. Discard tips after each use.
Seal the filter tray with the saved clear plastic seal.
Incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge at 2640 RPM for 1 minute.
Verify that lysate has passed through the filter into the skirted PCR plate; ensure equal liquid levels in all sample wells and the NTC.
Heat seal the plate.
Store the labeled array tray in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Label and Archive Trays
steps.instruction: Properly label the array trays for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Label the tray front (below row H) with: Full project name (no abbreviations), Extraction tray number, Extraction date, and Initials.
Before storing in the -80 °F freezer, label the top heat seal and the back skirt with the Progeny Container Name/-80 Tray Assignment Number.
